approval: Q selected alternative-candidate comparison, not production replacement
kind: Synthetic, independently authored development/heldout comparison; not release qualification

data.limitations: Synthetic template families are correlated; separate authors and blinding do not create real-world or human-adjudicated population evidence. CI criteria are applied numerically, not claimed as population guarantees.

order: Runtime-valid alternatives passing every existing release numeric criterion rank before failing alternatives
Then maximize the minimum of the four existing Wilson lower precision/recall bounds; undefined is zero
Then minimize existing overgeneralizationUpper; undefined is one
Then ascending immutable model ID for deterministic ties
selection.baseline: Current fixed FrameByFrame model is a control, not an alternative candidate
selection.allAlternativesFail: Select the strongest measured alternative for heldout diagnosis but recommend no production adoption
selection.lockBeforeHeldout: Persist selected model/revision/mapping and development report hashes before heldout is read for inference
selection.heldout: Run only selected alternative plus unchanged baseline; no reselection or tuning after heldout
selection.outputs: Counts, numeric bounds, row IDs/counts and runtime metadata only; no source text, token arrays or offsets
